definitions.explanation: The period of time just before eating a meal. Commonly used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts for when to take medication.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食前|しょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{食前|しょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}いましょう→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: Let's wash our hands before eating.

examples.japanese: {食前|しょくぜん}⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take it thirty minutes before meals.

notes:
Composed of {食|しょく} (meal/eating) + ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before). Most commonly encountered on medicine labels and pharmacy instructions, where it specifies when to take medication relative to meals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食前|しょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take (medicine) before meals
- {食前|しょくぜん}⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧: to be taken before meals
- {食前|しょくぜん}⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧: thirty minutes before meals
- {食前|しょくぜん}{酒|しゅ}: aperitif, pre-meal drink

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧: after a meal — the opposite; also common on medicine labels
- {食間|しょっかん}: between meals — another medication timing term (about 2 hours after eating)
- ⟦{空腹時|くうふくじ}→空腹時：17888_kuufukuji⟧: on an empty stomach — a related pharmaceutical term
